items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

New Zealand Nationals 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2019 will crown the National Champions in all 18 official events, over the course of 3 days.

Registration will happen on this WCA-page and is not considered complete before we have received the payment of the entry fee which has been set to 200 SEK. items.information:
Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve.
Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition.
**Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.**

**REPAS** :
Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition.
Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

items.information:
(HR)

Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. 

--------------

(EN)

Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.  Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019

venue.name: [Wellington College](https://www.wellington-college.school.nz/facility-hire)
venue.address: 15 Dufferin St, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6021, New Zealand

items.information:
Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then.
Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2019! Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 8 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year will be a 4 day competition, hosting all 18 WCA events. If you are not competiting in 3x3x3 FMC, 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 with Feet, Clock or Megaminx, there is no need to be present in Huskvarna on Thursday or Friday.

Please read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, however only competitors representing Sweden are eligeble for medals, prize money and the Swedish Champion titles.

-----

Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2019! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 8 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 4-dagarstävling med alla 18 WCA-grenar. Om du inte tänker delta i 3x3x3 FMC, 5x5x5, 6x6x6, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 med fötterna, Clock eller Megaminx så behöver du inte vara på plats i Huskvarna under torsdagen eller fredagen.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, prispengar och titeln Svensk Mästare.

venue.details: Enter at Månstorpsvägen 4, then go down into the basement where you´ll find the venue: Fritidslokalen

items.information:
Welcome to this blind events only competition in Tullinge, just outside Stockholm! We will only have blindsolving events at this competition. However, registration is free and the time-limits are lenient, so we would like to see many of you gathered for this competition in April! 

Please read through all the tabs on this page to get all the information you need for this competition. The main event of this competition is **3x3x3 Blindfolded**. If you have any further questions, feel free to contact the organizers using the contact information on this page. 

We are not allowed to wear outside shoes inside the venue, and the floor tend to get a bit cold as it is in a basement. Therefore, a good tip is to bring some slippers or inside shoes to keep your feet warm during the day.

-----

Varmt välkomna till denna tävling med bara blindgrenar i Tullinge, strax utanför Stockholm! Vi kommer bara ha blindgrenar på denna tävling. Det är dock gratis att delta och alla time-limits är generöst satta, så vi hoppas se många av er på denna tävling i april!

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att få all information om denna tävling. Tävlingens huvudgren är **3x3x3 med Ögonbindel** Om du har ytterligare frågor så går det bra att kontakta arrangörerna genom kontaktinformationen på denna sida.

Det är inte tillåtet att ha på sig utomhusskor inne i tävlingslokalen och golvet tenderar och bli ganska kallt då lokalen ligger i en källare. Därför är ett bra tips att ta med er ett par innetofflor eller inomhusskor för att hålla era fötter varma under tävlingen.

items.information:
Registration Fee:
There is a **$20** registration fee for the event, payable through the WCA Stripe payment system. Please note that even after payment, registrations need to be manually approved before appearing on the registration list, so you may still not be fully confirmed immediately after payment. Please keep an eye out for the e-mail saying you have been approved. Registration is on a first-come first-serve and the same will go for the waitlist once registration fills up. Please do not register unless you intend on competing as it will open up a spot for another competitor who does intend on competing.

**We will only be accepting online payment at this competition. If you have any issues with this, please contact us!**

There is a **25 competitor limit** to the competition. Please register as soon as possible if you plan on coming! Registration closes at the end of the day on July 7th. We will grant refunds to those who let us know by July 7th, but no refunds are granted after that date.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at [CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial](https://www.cubingusa.com/ctutorial.php).

Join the PNW Facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they are announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

This competition will take place on the 6th of June and it is the first competition ever in Heimaey!
To get to the island you need to go with a ferry called Herjólfur. The harbor is called Landeyjahöfn and is ~2 hours away from Reykjavík. It is possible to take a bus from there. You can order tickets to the ferry here - https://www.seatours.is/ .
You can check out booking.com or airbnb.com for information about hotels and other places to stay in over night.
Our goal with the schedule is to have events that were not held at Icelandic nationals.

Til þess að komast á eyjuna þarft þú að fara með ferjunni Herjólfi. Hann er staðsettur í Landeyjahöfn og er u.þ.b. tveggja klukkustunda keyrsla frá Reykjavík til Landeyjahafnar. Hægt er að taka strætó á milli staða.

items.name: Danish Open 2016
items.information:
Pris og registrering
Registreringen koster 100 dkr, og er forudbetalt.
Der er plads til 90 deltagere
Transport
Tog til Roskilde st. Og så Bus 123 mod Valby eller 600S mod Hillerød til Ros torv (stopper lige udenfor venue). Tjek rejseplanen.dk
Regelsæt
Denne konkurrence følger WCA regelsættet, det er derfor forventet at alle deltager er bekendt med dette. Alle deltagere er derfor også underforstået med at deres resultater vil blive publiceret på WCA's hjemmeside, inklusiv navn, nationalitet og køn.
Betalingspolitik
Aflysning: 
Hvis du tilmelder dig konkurrencen, men du ikke kan komme og du informerer os via e-mail, før den 3. juni, 2016 vil vi overføre halvdelen af ​​den betalte afgift tilbage.
Redigering af registrering: tilføje events: Skriv en mail med hvilke events du vil tilføje før 3. juni 2016.
Redigering registrering: fjerne events: Skriv en mail med hvilke events du vil fjernes fra før 3. juni 2016.
Registreringer uden betalinger: De registreringer uden betaling, vil blive slettet efter tilmeldingsfristen. (3. juni 2016.)
Acceptering af registreringer: Vi betragter en registrering for gyldig, når registreringen er færdig, og tilmeldingsgebyret er betalt. Vi vil først acceptere tilmeldingen efter begge disse betingelser er opfyldt.
Overnatning
Plads til 70 personer til overnatning på venue.
Det er først til mølle princippet, og det er gratis.
Kontakt Camilla (fam.nielsson@gmail.com )
Indkvartering kan fra fredag aften.
Man kan overnatte fra fredag til søndag.

items.name: Selandia Open 2016
items.information:
Information DK
Der vil være skilte på hoveddøren, og dørene åbner kl. 9:30.

Transport: Der er parkeringspladser ved venuen. Det er nemt at komme til venuen ved offentlig transport da der er mange togforbindelser til Slagelse St. Nærmere informationer kan findes på rejseplanen.dk, hvor destinationen kan sættes til stoppestedet 'Selandia'. Der er ca. 20 minutters gang fra Slagelse St. 

Mad: Der ligger en McDonald's og Burger King 2 km fra gymnasiet, og en Lidl 600 m fra gymnasiet. 

Overnatning: Det er ikke muligt at overnatte på venue.

Information EN
Follow the signs at the main entrance. The venue will open at 9 AM. 

Transport: There are parking spots at the venue. It is easy to commute to the venue by public transport, as many trains stop in Slagelse. You can take a train directly from the train station at Copenhagen Airport to Slagelse St., or a train from Copenhagen Airport to Copenhagen Central Station, and then a train to Slagelse St. Further information can be found on rejseplanen.dk, where the destination can be set to the bus stop 'Selandia' or Slagelse St. The walk from Slagelse St. to the venue is around 20 minutes. 

Food: There is a McDonald's and Burger King 2 km from the venue, and a grocery store 600 m from the venue. 

Accommodation: It is not possible to sleep at the venue, but there are following options:

Danhostel Slagelse (1,5 km) (http://danhostel-slagelse.dk/)
Hotel Frederik d.II (2,1 km) (http://www.fr2.dk/)
Hotel Antvorskov (3,2 km) (http://www.hotelantvorskov.dk/en/)
